hooks.name: property-test-companion
hooks.description: New core module gets a fast-check property test. Agent action: uses credits, so it is limited to the three pure-logic folders.

action.prompt: A new file was created in a pure-logic folder. If it is a test file or contains only types, do nothing. Otherwise create or update the sibling `<name>.prop.test.ts` with fast-check properties for the rules this module must always satisfy (round-trip, determinism under the same seed, monotonicity, rejection of invalid input). Run only that test file and report the real result, including any counterexample.
